question: What positive attributes must belong to the entity identified as the soul if it is to be the supreme reality distinct from all composite things?
premises: A definite entity is indicated by the demonstrative.
That entity is partless and eternal.
That entity is free from affliction and free from stain.
inference: The soul is defined as the supreme, partless, eternal, unblemished reality.
uncertainties: It is not stated here by negation alone what it is not, only what it is.
plain_english: He is the supreme, partless, eternal one, free from disease and stainless.
